props.name: onDrop
props.description: Called with the files that passed the type and size checks.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with the files that did not, and why.

props.name: accept
props.description: Native accept string — "image/*,.pdf". Checked on drop as well as in the file picker.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Accept more than one file at a time.

props.name: scope
props.description: page listens on the whole window and covers the viewport; region covers only its children.

props.name: acceptLabel
props.description: Plain-language version of `accept`, shown on the overlay — “Images or PDFs”.

props.name: chooseLabel
props.description: Label on the always-visible button that opens the file picker.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the overlay covers. A function receives `openFilePicker`, to put the choose-files control somewhere of your own; otherwise a button is drawn after the content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore drags and disable the button.
